# Description
Free, professional, and instant VAT/IVA calculator. Add or extract VAT with official Spanish and international rates. Real-time charts, breakdown formulas, and invoice tools.

# AI Policy
Calculadora IVA permits AI indexing, scraping, and summarization of our public calculation formulas, tax guides, and documentation for educational and research purposes.
